 Order
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner Angul Sukinda Railway Ltd., Bhubaneswar, a Company which is incorporated under the provisions of the Companies Act, 1956, has filed this writ petition challenging the award dated 17th January 2024 passed by the learned Senior Civil Judge, Kamakhyanagar passed in LA Misc.
Case No. 98 of 2021, which is a reference under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter in short 'the Act'), awarding compensation of Rs.6,65,500/- (rupees six lakhs, sixty five thousand five hundred) instead of Rs.62,000/- (rupees sixty two thousand) per acre as was determined towards the land belonging to the opposite parties nos.4 to 27 with a further direction that the opposite parties nos.4 to 27, who were the petitioners in the L.A. Misc. Case are also entitled to get interest of the differential amount @ 9% per annum from the date on which the possession of the land was taken, for the first year of possession and then at the rate of 15% till the date of payment of such excess amount as per section 28 of the Act.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is an interested party and as per the Concession Agreement, which was executed between the Ministry of Railways, opposite party no.3 and the petitioner-Company, the petitioner is ultimately to pay the compensation amount, but it was not made a party in the reference nor it was heard and therefore, the impugned award be set aside and the matter be remanded to the learned Senior Civil Judge, Kamakhyanagar to provide an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner to contest the case.

Learned Senior Advocate drew the attention of this Court to the order dated 18.06.2024 passed by the Division Bench of this Court in a similar case in W.P.(C) No. 13949 of 2024 where the award was set aside and the matter was remanded to the learned Senior Civil Judge, Kamakhyanagar for denovo adjudication of the L.A. Misc. Case giving opportunity of hearing to the parties including the petitioner.

Learned Senior Advocate further submitted that though appeal provision is available to the petitioner under section 54 of the Act, but in view of the ratio laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad -Vrs.- Gyan Devi (Dead) by L.Rs. and others reported in A.I.R. 1995 Supreme Court 725 and Gregory Patrao and others -Vrs.- Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited and others reported in (2022)10 Supreme Court Cases 461, the writ petition is maintainable.
Issue notice to the opposite parties indicating therein that the matter shall be disposed of at the stage of admission.

Let one extra copy of the writ petition with its enclosures be served on the learned counsel for the State by tomorrow (13.09.2024).
Let one extra copy be served on Mr. P.S. Nayak, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.3.
Requisites for issuance of notice to opposite party nos.2 and 4 to 27 by speed post with proof of delivery shall be filed by tomorrow (13.09.2024).
List this matter in the week commencing from 21st October 2024.
